readabilityReview: Reviewed at 24–32px: centered face or clearly framed narrative subject, no text or watermark.
officialUsageNotes: Official-source assets are Church Gospel Media crops. Confirm the current Gospel Media FAQ and Terms of Use before public or commercial distribution; preserve credit/source links and rights notices.
generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 1:1 scripture-person profile avatar. Primary request: centered head-and-shoulders portrait of the named subject. Style/medium: soft hand-painted historical editorial illustration, subtle paper grain, restrained earth tones, consistent family scripture portrait series. Composition/framing: square crop, face and shoulders centered, eyes in upper third, simple warm background, readable at 24px. Lighting/mood: calm, dignified, contemplative. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no logo, no modern clothing, no exaggerated props, no photorealistic identity claim.
